structure_reference: partner_dv_dbt / travel_dv_dbt -- models/staging/<lob>/ and models/automate_dv/{standard/{stitched,staging,hubs,links,satellites,references},augmented/{staging,satellites}}, the same layout as health_consolidated_v5, maximus_health_v4 and opus_motor_v3. No resolver, hub_feed, proposed, reject_log or assertions layer.

inputs_pinned.note: EXACTLY the mapping motor_maximus_dv_dbt was built from: the 42 of its 43 pinned bundle files whose sha256 still matches BOTH its inputs/ copy and the live bundle, read in place from outputs/, plus data_7.js. The mapper's RUN_STATE.md records the handoff (s17) and the build's closure (s19); its open items are carried here as directives.

not_read.SourceMapping_Skill/Motor Maximus Mappin: the workbook's bytes match neither the sha256 motor_maximus_dv_dbt recorded for it nor anything else on record (its inputs/ copy and the live bundle agree with each other). It is not a build input -- the build reads 04_column_map.json, which matches.

central_view_rule.verbatim: 1. we create a central view from source tables (by joining them , max upto 10). The join are selected so that it can feed sat as a whole (one or moew). That is we do not split sat across these views. Restriction of 10 can be broken if a sat needs more than source tables to build. If a view as less source tables join, we add more tables to it efficiently so that new sats can be built.
central_view_rule.hub_and_link_extension_verbatim: the views will have hub keys -- effectively each sat is primary key goes to hub -- so hub has to come from there, 2nd the links will also be from same view , as different hub keys and sat populatin comes from there
central_view_rule.what_counts_toward_the_limit: the source tables whose rows FEED the view. Ancestor and sibling tables joined only to resolve a spine walk are lookups for a key and are listed per view as walk tables.

spine.span_types: spine[...] (climb, '->') and cross_via_root[... -> ROOT >> TARGET] (climb to the root, then descend). BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS s1.2: classify by operator, verify against the graph.
spine.start_forms: spine[PARENT_KEY_HASH -> ...], spine[<own view> -> ...] and spine[<own view>.PARENT_KEY_HASH -> <view>.KEY_HASH -> ...] are one climb: child.PARENT_KEY_HASH = parent.KEY_HASH, one join per REAL level. A hop name is the full view name or, where the map abbreviates it, the name relative to the row's root (root + '_' + name).
spine.descend: only where exactly one distinct value exists under the ancestor; a 1:N descend gives NULL and the row is rejected, never a pick.

normalise_note: normalise() is one of the six functions BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS s1.2 calls 'all ratified', and is defined nowhere in the bundle or this workspace. 'emit' carries it verbatim and declares a precondition. health_consolidated_v5_dv_dbt refuses it; settle once, estate-wide.

directives.empty_key_shell: a resolved_key object with no expression is refused (source) -- including the declared keyless insured party on the CLM pivot; 'CUST:' is never borrowed from a cousin view.

withheld_unruled.why: BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS s5.2: written on the PROPOSER's key with no instance; never ruled. Withheld as agreed at closure (RUN_STATE s18/s19) until a source answer.

directives.link_leg_identity: a link leg must equal the hub key of the hub it references on that view; a leg that differs from every key form of that hub on the view is WITHHELD, not emitted non-joining.
directives.risk_object_interest_grain: blocks whose resolved_key.note declares HUB_RISK_OBJECT keyed at interest grain are emitted as stated and every satellite they feed carries a DUAL-GRAIN banner; the two grains are never unified.
directives.two_writers_declared: SAT_POLICY_COVERAGE_SCHEDULE 'Coverage Start Date' keeps its two writers (no redundant_of invented); where two writers of one single-active attribute meet on one row, the merge is stated per group in build_artifacts/reports/single_writer_decisions.json.
directives.vehicle_ladder: emitted exactly as the map writes it; never re-ordered or re-spelt.
directives.report_not_gate: a per-hop audit that cannot resolve a name REPORTS, it never gates a key (RUN_STATE s19: gating on an incomplete reader withheld half the key surface).

conventions.role_satellites: satellites on the one-hub LNK_PARTY_ROLE are built off HUB_PARTY with a literal ROLE_TYPE_CK
conventions.load_datetime: !CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()  -- as the reference projects write it, by the user's instruction
conventions.payload_names: UPPER_SNAKE of the data_7.js attribute name

staging_casts: every column nullif(trim(to_varchar("COL")), '') aliased lower-case, shred keys included.
refusals_not_fallbacks: A key, child key, walk or attribute that cannot be resolved from the pinned inputs is REFUSED and registered with whose call it is.
